text: The clearing has gone still after the failed wish.
I remain where I stood through the rite, seal band tight across my mouth.
The assembly watches without speaking.

speaker: the presiding Dohkar
text: "The rite stands. The misalignment is noted."
His voice carries across the spiralgrass without effort.

speaker: the presiding Dohkar
text: "A preliminary review will convene in three days at the Open."

speaker: the presiding Dohkar
text: "A Chayr and two Dohkars will hear the matter of the Sacrificiant's conduct."
The words land like a measured step onto new ground.
I feel the assembly shift their attention toward me.

speaker: the presiding Dohkar
text: "No interference will be tolerated in future rites."
Seren remains kneeling, her coral hair catching the last light.
Julian has not moved from the edge of the circle.

speaker: the presiding Dohkar
text: "The assumption stands unless challenged."
His gaze does not seek mine.
I taste the choice already forming behind the seal.

speaker: the presiding Dohkar
text: "Three days."
The assembly begins to disperse in small, careful steps.
Julian's silver script catches the failing light as he turns his head.
The weight of the unclaimed assumption settles across the clearing.
I do not speak.
The Dohkar's words have already become fact.
Julian watches without moving closer.
The choice sits between my silence and whatever comes after.
I do not know which path the assembly expects me to walk.
